- category: duplication
- title: config.env bootstrap (copy-template + source + validate) duplicated between build_runtime.sh and setup.sh, with a third variant in tests/lib/paths.sh

Extracting one shared loader (e.g. scripts/lib/config_env.sh) sourced by both scripts removes the duplication and makes the precedence choice live in exactly one place. 1	#!/usr/bin/env bash
2	# Build the user-facing andesim runtime (runtime/) for both arches. Produces:
3	#   build/runtime/       libandesim_runtime.a, crt0.o, andesim.ld, andesim.specs,
4	#                        include/andesim/ROI.h   (rv64; link -B build/runtime)
5	#   build/runtime/rv32/  the same, rv32          (rv32; link -B build/runtime/rv32)
6	# Users link with `-B <dir> -specs=andesim.specs` (USER_GUIDE.md section 4).
7	#
8	# rv64 always builds (HYBRID_TOOLCHAIN). rv32 builds too when HYBRID_TOOLCHAIN32
9	# is set. Self-contained: fills either toolchain from config.env (exported env
10	# wins), like setup.sh, so it runs without `source ./setup.sh` first.
11	set -euo pipefail
12	
13	ROOT="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")/.." && pwd)"
14	SRC="$ROOT/runtime"
15	CONFIG_FILE="$ROOT/config.env"
16	CONFIG_TEMPLATE="$ROOT/config.env.example"
17	
18	[[ -f "$SRC/Makefile" ]] || { echo "missing $SRC/Makefile" >&2; exit 1; }
19	
20	# Capture exported values (they win), then source config.env to fill any gaps.
21	ENV_TC64="${HYBRID_TOOLCHAIN:-}"
22	ENV_TC32="${HYBRID_TOOLCHAIN32:-}"
23	if [[ -z "$ENV_TC64" || -z "$ENV_TC32" ]]; then
24	  if [[ ! -f "$CONFIG_FILE" ]]; then
25	    [[ -f "$CONFIG_TEMPLATE" ]] \
26	      || { echo "missing $CONFIG_TEMPLATE; cannot create $CONFIG_FILE" >&2; exit 1; }
27	    cp "$CONFIG_TEMPLATE" "$CONFIG_FILE"
28	    echo "created $CONFIG_FILE from template -- edit it if your toolchains live elsewhere" >&2
29	  fi
30	  # shellcheck source=/dev/null
31	  . "$CONFIG_FILE"
32	fi
33	[[ -n "$ENV_TC64" ]] && HYBRID_TOOLCHAIN="$ENV_TC64"
34	[[ -n "$ENV_TC32" ]] && HYBRID_TOOLCHAIN32="$ENV_TC32"
35	
36	# rv64 (required).
37	if [[ -z "${HYBRID_TOOLCHAIN:-}" || ! -d "${HYBRID_TOOLCHAIN:-}/bin" ]]; then
38	  echo "HYBRID_TOOLCHAIN unset or has no bin/; check $CONFIG_FILE" >&2
39	  exit 1
40	fi
41	make -C "$SRC" ARCH=rv64 TOOLCHAIN="$HYBRID_TOOLCHAIN"
42	echo "built: $ROOT/build/runtime/libandesim_runtime.a (rv64)"
43	
44	# rv32 (optional: needs the second toolchain).
45	if [[ -n "${HYBRID_TOOLCHAIN32:-}" && -d "${HYBRID_TOOLCHAIN32:-}/bin" ]]; then
46	  make -C "$SRC" ARCH=rv32 TOOLCHAIN="$HYBRID_TOOLCHAIN32"
47	  echo "built: $ROOT/build/runtime/rv32/libandesim_runtime.a (rv32)"
48	else
49	  echo "skipped rv32 runtime: set HYBRID_TOOLCHAIN32 in $CONFIG_FILE to build it" >&2
50	fi
51

1	#!/usr/bin/env bash
2	# Driver: build the plugin (qemu and vsim are external, prebuilt), then add the
3	# external build dirs to PATH.
4	# Source this script to affect your current shell's PATH:
5	#   source ./setup.sh                       # build all
6	#   source ./setup.sh clean [target]        # clean vsim|plugin|all (default: all)
7	
8	if [ -n "${ZSH_VERSION:-}" ]; then
9	  _SETUP_SRC="${(%):-%x}"
10	elif [ -n "${BASH_VERSION:-}" ]; then
11	  _SETUP_SRC="${BASH_SOURCE[0]}"
12	else
13	  _SETUP_SRC="$0"
14	fi
15	
16	# Wrap the body in a function so strict-mode options stay local and don't
17	# leak into the caller's interactive shell (which would break zsh prompts
18	# under nounset).
19	_hybrid_setup_main() {
20	  if [ -n "${ZSH_VERSION:-}" ]; then
21	    emulate -L sh
22	    setopt err_exit no_unset pipe_fail
23	  else
24	    local -
25	    set -euo pipefail
26	  fi
27	
28	  # QEMU_BIN_DIR / VSIM_BIN_DIR are NOT in this local list: they are exported
29	  # for the caller's shell at the end of this function, and exporting a local
30	  # dies at function return (the shell pops the scope, children never see it).
31	  local ROOT PLUGIN_DIR PLUGIN_SO CONFIG_FILE CONFIG_TEMPLATE _arch
32	  ROOT="$(cd "$(dirname "$_SETUP_SRC")" && pwd)"
33	  # QEMU_BIN_DIR and VSIM_BIN_DIR (the externally-built qemu-system-* and vsim
34	  # sim_* build directories) both come from config.env -- this project integrates
35	  # a prebuilt QEMU and a prebuilt external vsim; it builds neither.
36	  PLUGIN_DIR="$ROOT/qemu_plugin"
37	  PLUGIN_SO="$PLUGIN_DIR/libhybrid_handoff.so"
38	  CONFIG_FILE="$ROOT/config.env"
39	  CONFIG_TEMPLATE="$ROOT/config.env.example"
40	
41	  step() { printf '\033[1;34m==>\033[0m \033[1m%s\033[0m\n' "$*"; }
42	  ok()   { printf '\033[1;32m[ok]\033[0m %s\n' "$*"; }
43	  err()  { printf '\033[1;31m[err]\033[0m %s\n' "$*" >&2; }
44	
45	  clean_vsim()   { step "vsim is external (${VSIM_BIN_DIR:-unset})"; ok "not cleaned here -- clean it in your external vsim checkout"; }
46	  clean_plugin() {
47	    step "cleaning plugin build ($PLUGIN_DIR)"
48	    if [ -f "$PLUGIN_DIR/Makefile" ]; then
49	      make -C "$PLUGIN_DIR" clean
50	    else
51	      rm -f "$PLUGIN_SO" "$PLUGIN_DIR"/*.o
52	    fi
53	    ok "plugin cleaned"
54	  }
55	
56	  if [ "${1:-}" = "clean" ]; then
57	    case "${2:-all}" in
58	      vsim)     clean_vsim ;;
59	      plugin)   clean_plugin ;;
60	      all)      clean_vsim; clean_plugin ;;
61	      *)        err "usage: source $_SETUP_SRC clean [vsim|plugin|all]"; return 1 ;;
62	    esac
63	    return 0
64	  fi
65	
66	  step "0/3 loading per-host config"
67	  if [ ! -f "$CONFIG_FILE" ]; then
68	    if [ ! -f "$CONFIG_TEMPLATE" ]; then
69	      err "missing $CONFIG_TEMPLATE; cannot create $CONFIG_FILE"
70	      return 1
71	    fi
72	    cp "$CONFIG_TEMPLATE" "$CONFIG_FILE"
73	    ok "created $CONFIG_FILE from template -- edit it if your toolchain lives elsewhere"
74	  fi
75	  # shellcheck source=/dev/null
76	  . "$CONFIG_FILE"
77	  if [ -z "${HYBRID_TOOLCHAIN:-}" ]; then
78	    err "HYBRID_TOOLCHAIN not set; check $CONFIG_FILE"
79	    return 1
80	  fi
81	  if [ ! -d "$HYBRID_TOOLCHAIN/bin" ]; then
82	    err "HYBRID_TOOLCHAIN=$HYBRID_TOOLCHAIN has no bin/ directory; edit $CONFIG_FILE"
83	    return 1
84	  fi
85	  export HYBRID_TOOLCHAIN
86	  ok "HYBRID_TOOLCHAIN=$HYBRID_TOOLCHAIN"
87	
88	  step "1/3 locating external qemu (rv32 + rv64)"
89	  if [ -z "${QEMU_BIN_DIR:-}" ]; then
90	    err "QEMU_BIN_DIR not set; point it at your qemu-system-* build dir in $CONFIG_FILE"
91	    return 1
92	  fi
93	  for _arch in riscv32 riscv64; do
94	    if [ ! -x "$QEMU_BIN_DIR/qemu-system-$_arch" ]; then
95	      err "no qemu-system-$_arch under QEMU_BIN_DIR=$QEMU_BIN_DIR; build both rv32+rv64 QEMU there or edit $CONFIG_FILE"
96	      return 1
97	    fi
98	  done
99	  ok "qemu <- $QEMU_BIN_DIR/qemu-system-{riscv32,riscv64} (external, prebuilt)"
100	
101	  step "2/3 locating external vsim"
102	  if [ -z "${VSIM_BIN_DIR:-}" ]; then
103	    err "VSIM_BIN_DIR not set; point it at your external vsim build dir (holding sim_* binaries) in $CONFIG_FILE"
104	    return 1
105	  fi
106	  if ! ls "$VSIM_BIN_DIR"/sim_* >/dev/null 2>&1; then
107	    err "no sim_* under VSIM_BIN_DIR=$VSIM_BIN_DIR; build vsim in your external checkout or edit $CONFIG_FILE"
108	    return 1
109	  fi
110	  ok "vsim <- $VSIM_BIN_DIR (external, prebuilt)"
111	
112	  step "3/3 building hybrid plugin"
113	  if [ ! -f "$PLUGIN_DIR/Makefile" ]; then
114	    err "missing $PLUGIN_DIR/Makefile"
115	    return 1
116	  fi
117	  # Plugins build against the vendored qemu_plugin/include/qemu-plugin.h -- no
118	  # QEMU source tree required.
119	  make -C "$PLUGIN_DIR"
120	  ok "plugin -> $PLUGIN_SO"

1	# Shared path resolution for the top-level e2e harness + drivers.
2	# Sourced (not executed). Provides:
3	#   TOP_ROOT                  - absolute path of the repo root
4	#   hybrid_resolve_paths()    - sets VSIM_BIN, VSIM_QEMU, VSIM_PLUGIN,
5	#                               VSIM_ELF from TOP_ROOT (unless already
6	#                               exported by caller) and exits 77 (CTest
7	#                               skip) if any artifact is missing. Reads
8	#                               FIXTURE for the VSIM_ELF default.
9	#   hybrid_describe_int F [BIN] - print integer field F from an engine's
10	#                               --describe JSON (BIN defaults to $VSIM_BIN);
11	#                               empty output if absent/unprobeable. The ONE
12	#                               shell parser of the descriptor wire format.
13	
14	TESTS_LIB_DIR=$(cd -- "$(dirname -- "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")" && pwd)
15	TOP_ROOT=$(cd -- "$TESTS_LIB_DIR/../.." && pwd)
16	
17	if [ -z "${HYBRID_TOOLCHAIN:-}" ] && [ -f "$TOP_ROOT/config.env" ]; then
18	  . "$TOP_ROOT/config.env"
19	fi
20	
21	hybrid_resolve_paths() {
22	  # VSIM_BIN_DIR / QEMU_BIN_DIR come from the environment or from the
23	  # config.env sourced above; there is no in-tree fallback (both simulators
24	  # are external prebuilts). Unset -> a nonexistent path -> skip below.
25	  VSIM_BIN="${VSIM_BIN:-${VSIM_BIN_DIR:-}/sim_ax45mpv_premium}"
26	  VSIM_QEMU="${VSIM_QEMU:-${QEMU_BIN_DIR:-}/qemu-system-riscv64}"
27	  VSIM_PLUGIN="${VSIM_PLUGIN:-$TOP_ROOT/qemu_plugin/libhybrid_handoff.so}"
28	  VSIM_ELF="${VSIM_ELF:-$TOP_ROOT/tests/fixtures/${FIXTURE}.elf}"
29	  for f in "$VSIM_BIN" "$VSIM_QEMU" "$VSIM_PLUGIN" "$VSIM_ELF"; do
30	    if [ ! -e "$f" ]; then
31	      echo "skip: $f not built; run 'source ./setup.sh' and 'make -C tests/fixtures'"
32	      exit 77
33	    fi
34	  done
35	}
36	
37	# Extract one integer field from an engine's --describe JSON. $1 = field name,
38	# $2 = engine binary (default $VSIM_BIN). Prints nothing when the field is
39	# absent or the binary cannot be probed, so callers can `[ -n ... ]`-gate.
40	hybrid_describe_int() {
41	  "${2:-$VSIM_BIN}" --describe 2>/dev/null \
42	    | sed -n "s/.*\"$1\": *\([0-9][0-9]*\).*/\1/p" | head -n1
43	}
44	
45	# Write a 32-bit little-endian word into a binary file (pattern staging for
46	# the LM/HVM backdoor-load tests). $1 = file, $2 = byte offset, $3 = value.
47	put_word_le() {
48	  local v=$3 bytes="" i
49	  for i in 0 8 16 24; do
50	    bytes+=$(printf '\\x%02x' $(( (v >> i) & 0xff )))
51	  done
52	  # shellcheck disable=SC2059
53	  printf "$bytes" | dd of="$1" bs=1 seek="$2" conv=notrunc status=none
54	}

1	#!/usr/bin/env bash
2	# build_all.sh -- build the andesim artifacts. This is the entry point that
3	# replaced the former `andesim build` subcommand (which moved out of the driver
4	# binary). It only orchestrates the existing build scripts / Makefiles; the
5	# build logic itself lives in setup.sh, scripts/build_*.sh, and the Makefiles.
6	#
7	# Usage:
8	#   scripts/build_all.sh [TARGET] [--dry-run]
9	#
10	# TARGET (default: all):
11	#   all       setup.sh (locate external qemu + vsim + plugin) then
12	#             fixtures (the fixtures Makefile also builds the runtime lib too)
13	#             then vlinux
14	#   plugin    qemu_plugin/libhybrid_handoff.so
15	#   fixtures  tests/fixtures/*.elf (+ runtime lib)
16	#   runtime   build/runtime/ (rv64) + build/runtime/rv32/ (rv32, when
17	#             HYBRID_TOOLCHAIN32 is set): libandesim_runtime.a, crt0.o,
18	#             andesim.ld, andesim.specs, include/andesim/ROI.h
19	#   vlinux    build/runtime/linux/vlinux.elf (the vlinux proxy-kernel
20	#             skeleton, ROADMAP_LINUX_RUNTIME.md; depends on the runtime
21	#             lib, built automatically)
22	#
23	# --dry-run prints the underlying commands without running them.
24	#
25	# The andesim driver itself is NOT built here: ./andesim self-bootstraps via
26	# scripts/build_driver.sh on first use.
27	set -euo pipefail
28	
29	ROOT="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")/.." && pwd)"
30	
31	TARGET=all
32	DRY_RUN=0
33	for arg in "$@"; do
34	  case "$arg" in
35	    --dry-run) DRY_RUN=1 ;;
36	    all|plugin|fixtures|runtime|vlinux) TARGET="$arg" ;;
37	    *)
38	      echo "build_all.sh: unknown argument: $arg" >&2
39	      echo "usage: build_all.sh [all|plugin|fixtures|runtime|vlinux] [--dry-run]" >&2
40	      exit 2
41	      ;;
42	  esac
43	done
44	
45	# run one step: print it under --dry-run, otherwise banner + execute (inheriting
46	# stdio so the user watches the build live). set -e aborts on the first failure.
47	run() {
48	  if [ "$DRY_RUN" = "1" ]; then
49	    printf '%s\n' "$*"
50	    return
51	  fi
52	  printf '[build_all] %s\n' "$*"
53	  "$@"
54	}
55	
56	# plugin: build_qemu_plugin.sh wraps `make -C qemu_plugin`; plugins build against
57	# the vendored qemu_plugin/include/qemu-plugin.h (no QEMU source tree needed).
58	case "$TARGET" in
59	  all)      run bash "$ROOT/setup.sh"; run make -C "$ROOT/tests/fixtures"; run make -C "$ROOT/runtime/linux" ;;
60	  plugin)   run bash "$ROOT/scripts/build_qemu_plugin.sh" ;;
61	  fixtures) run make -C "$ROOT/tests/fixtures" ;;
62	  runtime)  run bash "$ROOT/scripts/build_runtime.sh" ;;
63	  vlinux)   run make -C "$ROOT/runtime/linux" ;;
64	esac

1	#!/usr/bin/env bash
2	# Contract for scripts/build_all.sh -- the build entry point that replaced the
3	# removed `andesim build` subcommand. Verified via --dry-run (prints the
4	# underlying commands without running them), so the test needs no toolchain.
5	set -uo pipefail
6	
7	SCRIPT_DIR=$(cd -- "$(dirname -- "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")" && pwd)
8	ROOT=$(cd -- "$SCRIPT_DIR/../.." && pwd)
9	. "$SCRIPT_DIR/../lib/log.sh"
10	
11	BUILD_ALL="$ROOT/scripts/build_all.sh"
12	[ -x "$BUILD_ALL" ] || fail "scripts/build_all.sh missing or not executable"
13	
14	# 1. default target = all: setup.sh (locate external qemu/vsim + build plugin)
15	#    then fixtures.
16	OUT=$(bash "$BUILD_ALL" --dry-run 2>&1) || fail "build_all.sh --dry-run rc!=0: $OUT"
17	printf '%s\n' "$OUT" | grep -q 'setup.sh'       || fail "default --dry-run missing setup.sh:"$'\n'"$OUT"
18	printf '%s\n' "$OUT" | grep -q 'tests/fixtures' || fail "default --dry-run missing fixtures:"$'\n'"$OUT"
19	# dry-run must NOT execute (no [build_all] run banner).
20	printf '%s\n' "$OUT" | grep -q '\[build_all\]'  && fail "dry-run should not run steps:"$'\n'"$OUT"
21	ok "build_all.sh --dry-run (all): setup.sh + fixtures, nothing executed"
22	
23	# 2. per-target dry-runs mirror the former `build --what T`.
24	declare -A WANT=(
25	  [plugin]='qemu_plugin'
26	  [fixtures]='tests/fixtures' [runtime]='build_runtime.sh'
27	)
28	for t in plugin fixtures runtime; do
29	  O=$(bash "$BUILD_ALL" "$t" --dry-run 2>&1) || fail "build_all.sh $t --dry-run rc!=0: $O"
30	  printf '%s\n' "$O" | grep -q "${WANT[$t]}" || fail "$t --dry-run missing ${WANT[$t]}:"$'\n'"$O"
31	done
32	ok "build_all.sh per-target dry-runs (plugin/fixtures/runtime)"
33	
34	# qemu and vsim are no longer build targets: both are prebuilt externals
35	# (config.env QEMU_BIN_DIR / VSIM_BIN_DIR), not built in-repo.
36	for t in qemu vsim; do
37	  O=$(bash "$BUILD_ALL" "$t" --dry-run 2>&1); rc=$?
38	  [ "$rc" = "2" ] || fail "removed '$t' target should exit 2 (unknown), got $rc: $O"
39	done
40	ok "build_all.sh 'qemu'/'vsim' targets removed (prebuilt externals)"
41	
42	# 3. unknown target -> usage error (rc 2).
43	O=$(bash "$BUILD_ALL" bogus --dry-run 2>&1); rc=$?
44	[ "$rc" = "2" ] || fail "unknown target should exit 2, got $rc: $O"
45	ok "build_all.sh unknown target exits 2"

input.reason: Duplication claim is factually accurate (verified: build_runtime.sh:20-40, setup.sh:66-86, paths.sh:17-19, identical missing-template text, precedence divergence confirmed - config.env.example uses plain assignments so setup.sh's unconditional source at line 76 clobbers exported vars while build_runtime.sh captures env first; no cross-repo consumers in andesim-demo or vsim_andesim; no test pins the messages). But the "pure extraction, nothing changes" safety claim understates the work: the truly identical code is ~2 lines (cp + source). Concrete behavior-change risks: (1) setup.sh runs SOURCED and uses `return 1` - a shared helper using `exit 1` (build_runtime.sh's style) kills the user's interactive shell on error; (2) output is NOT identical between sites - setup.sh renders via colored err()/ok() (ok() to stdout), build_runtime.sh plain echo to stderr, and validation/created-config message texts differ (split vs combined; "toolchain lives" vs "toolchains live") - sharing message emission changes observable text/streams; (3) build_runtime.sh skips template-copy entirely when both HYBRID_TOOLCHAIN/HYBRID_TOOLCHAIN32 are exported, setup.sh always creates config.env - a unified always-copy loader changes file-layout side effects; (4) config.env.example:7-9 documents env-wins, inviting a "fix" of setup.sh's file-wins semantics during extraction, which would be a behavioral change; (5) HYBRID_TOOLCHAIN export scope from within a helper function has a documented past regression (tests/setup/test_setup_exports.sh header) guarded only by a MANUAL test not in run_e2e.sh. Extraction is feasible only with heavy per-caller parameterization (precedence flag, injected printers, exact texts, return-not-exit, TC32, copy condition), at which point the shared body is near-empty; a simpler unification WILL alter observable behavior.
